allow: Bash(sqlite3 -header prisma/dev.db "SELECT substr\(id,1,12\) AS id, substr\(title,1,26\) AS title, source, audioUrl IS NOT NULL AS has_audio, status, recordingEnded IS NOT NULL AS ended FROM Meeting ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 4;")

hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); echo "$path" | grep -q '\.env' && echo 'Blocked: .env is protected' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
